description:
Amendment 0004 (P04) to RFQ 36C25526Q0617, Fire Alarm, Smoke and Automatic Door Inspection and Testing Services (IDIQ). The purpose of this amendment is to extend the quote due date to November 20, 2026, 3:00 PM CST. The previous due date was 11/10/2026 1500 CST. All other terms and conditions remain unchanged. Offerors must acknowledge this amendment by signing and returning the SF30 with their quote, or as otherwise stated in the amendment. Offerors who already submitted a quote may submit a revised quote by the new due date. If no revised quote is received, the quote already on file will be considered.
